item.title: Russia's Geran-5 Drone Can Reach 370 MPH
item.description: Satellite images show Russia's new Rostov drone-launch site expanded to roughly 126 soccer fields in six weeks, alongside developments in faster jet-powered attack drones.

item.title: Bugonia's Ending Kills Humanity but Spares Nature
item.description: In Bugonia's final scene, Emma Stone's character decides humanity has failed, instantly eliminating human life while Earth's animals and plants survive.

item.title: Lil Durk's Acquittal Sparks Chicago Conspiracy Theory
item.description: Following Lil Durk's September 2026 acquittal, a commentator claims that viral controversies were deliberately used to divert attention from violence in Chicago. The alleged connections remain unsubstantiated.
